event.label: Walcha councillor by-election following Adam Iuston resignation
event.status: Council endorsed a preferred date; official timetable awaited
event.dateBasis: Adam Iuston resigned effective 23 October 2026. Walcha Council’s 28 October draft minutes record a unanimous decision endorsing the NSW Electoral Commission’s preferred by-election date of Saturday 16 January 2027. An issued electoral timetable, nomination dates and polling hours remain unverified.

priorRepresentationReview: Adam Iuston resigned effective 23 October 2026. One councillor vacancy awaits the NSWEC by-election timetable. Hyde Thomson is Mayor and Rachel Greig Deputy Mayor; Eric Noakes and Glen O’Brien remain councillors. Council sources disagree on 29 or 30 September for the internal mayoral selection; exact role start dates are not asserted. Checked 2 November 2026.
